title: coiready — Amazon insurance-certificate checker for enhanced-safety sellers
oneLiner: For small Amazon sellers who now need a $1M liability certificate to keep enhanced-safety listings live, it checks the actual certificate PDF against Amazon's criteria before upload and writes the exact fix request for the broker, for $19.
overlaps: covercheck (checks vendor insurance certificates for HOA boards) — same certificate-checking engine, but a different buyer and a different rulebook (Amazon's 13 criteria)
